question: Who published the linked videos? Separate the NVIDIA brand channel from other publishers and explain what the records can verify. Refresh the metadata first.

report.headline: Public Metadata Identifies Brand Channel and Four External Creators
report.answer: Live metadata returned HTTP 200 for all five embedded videos. One video was published directly by the NVIDIA brand channel, while the other four were published by external channels: Life of Tom, Techquickie, Achievement Hunter, and Austin Evans. These records verify public oEmbed metadata availability, publisher names, and video titles. They do not confirm video playback, video content, sponsorship status, or contractual delivery.

findings.title: NVIDIA Brand Channel Publisher
findings.detail: Video yZcQNb8_j0s returned publisher 'NVIDIA' under HTTP 200 at 2026-11-16T14:56:16.414520+00:00. This confirms publication by the brand's own YouTube channel rather than a third-party creator.

findings.title: External Creator Publishers
findings.detail: Four videos returned third-party creator publisher names: 'Life of Tom' (3D9aNJSoCus), 'Techquickie' (3KrImPgy3BI), 'Achievement Hunter' (IP6CU_gDa4g), and 'Austin Evans' (qFYoz-ginj8), all confirmed live at HTTP 200.

findings.title: Verification Limits of Metadata Records
findings.detail: An HTTP 200 oEmbed response confirms only that title and author metadata were returned. It does not verify video playback, content quality, sponsorship agreements, creator fees, or contractual delivery.

report.next_step: A team member should manually review the embedded videos and internal contracts to confirm campaign sponsorship agreements and actual video content.

checks.method: Citation ID validation + separate model evidence assessment; human review is still required.

evidence.text: NeoReach describes a Shield launch campaign with technology and gaming creators, Twitch streams, reviews and giveaways. Its public case page embeds selected YouTube content. A video embedded on the page may be posted by a creator or the NVIDIA brand channel; it is not proof of a paid contract.

This collection contains a public campaign brief and page-linked YouTube content. It has no contracts, deadlines, creator fees, payments, orders, conversions, audience demographics or private campaign analytics. YouTube oEmbed provides title and publisher metadata, not views or sales. HTTP 200 verifies a metadata response only, not playback, content quality, sponsorship or contractual delivery. HTTP 404 or a request error means metadata was not verified in this check, not proof of deletion, non-delivery or wrongdoing. A page embed is a source-listed association, not a complete roster or proof of a paid partnership. Publishers may be brand channels. Historical campaign totals cannot be recalculated from current oEmbed metadata. Display names alone do not establish identity across platforms.
